decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric was moved from its own page to a simple mention, which suggests lower priority, but upholstery fabrics usually stay in collections for several years.
The semi-transparent bouclé decorative fabric has been listed steadily in both years and fits current trends, so it stays as part of the broad collection.
The flame-retardant jacquard curtain fabric serves contract and hospitality demand and kept its own page, so it is a key functional product.
The double-face wool-blend fabric uses a renewable fibre in line with the sustainability strategy and has been listed consistently.
The wool bouclé leno fabric fits the move toward renewable materials and remains listed, though it may be trimmed in a future collection update.
The braided-structure fabric is the newest launch and is featured on its own page, so it is actively promoted.
